title: A Place in the Sun
description: A social climber (Montgomery Clift) in love with a wealthy beauty (Elizabeth Taylor) figures out how to get rid of his poor, pregnant girlfriend (Shelley Winters).

title: Breaker Morant
description: Australian Lt. Morant and two fellow officers are court-martialed for executing Boer War prisoners.

title: The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes
description:
S05 E01 — The Disappearance Of Lady Frances Carfax
Watson's encounter with Lady Frances Carfax brings Holmes rushing to the Lake District.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E11 — Bat Masterson Wins His Star
Bat Masterson travels to Dodge City and gets involved in a gunfight that causes him to lose Earp's approval; after befriending gang member Nellie Wright, Bat tries to get word to Earp about an upcoming robbery but ends up at the gang's mercy.

title: Rimfire
description: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E12 — The Lonesomest Man in the World
A newly deputized Bat complicates an arrest by shooting perpetrator Billy Jordan after Billy ran out of bullets; while Earp and the deputies race to find a surgeon, Billy's family holds Bat hostage and threatens to take revenge if Billy dies.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E13 — Take Back Your Town
With Earp and Bassett out of town, George Morris' gang sacks Dodge City and rounds up all the remaining deputies except for Bat, who finds Earp and sneaks back into town to fight the gang with the help of local residents.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E15 — The Hanging Judge
Earp must get Judge Tobin to see the error of his ways when the judge sentences an innocent man to death by hanging, going to extreme lengths to turn the tables by framing the judge for a crime.

title: The Catholic Mass
description: The Heart of the nation Sunday mass brings the beauty and traditions of the Catholic faith.

title: Perry Stone
description: Religious teachings from Perry Stone.

title: 2026 Silver Eagle is here & it is a once-in-a-lifetime coin!
description: Join your hosts Kevin Cash & Cory Cady as we discuss the 250th Anniversary of America with the official "America 250" logo on a Silver American Eagle label; we are locking in orders for this iconic release, but coins are limited! Don't miss out!

title: The Forty-Niners
description: A U.S. marshal (Wild Bill Elliott) roams gold camps as a gunman to find a gambler (Henry Morgan) who knows more about a federal case.

title: The Tall Texan
description: A band of treasure-seekers sets out in search of gold that is reputedly concealed in an Indian burial ground.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Inside Straight
description: A tycoon's (David Brian) life story unfolds as he plays poker, with a bank at stake, in 1870s San Francisco.

title: The Outriders
description: An escaped Confederate (Joel McCrea) and his two partners lead a wagon train of Union gold into an ambush.

title: 12 Angry Men
description: One (Henry Fonda) of 12 jurors holds out in the case of a boy from the slums who is accused of killing his father.

title: Mister Roberts
description: Ensign Pulver (Jack Lemmon) plots cargo officer Mr. Roberts' (Henry Fonda) escape from their nit-picking captain (James Cagney).

title: The Long Voyage Home
description: Merchant seamen (Thomas Mitchell, Ian Hunter) on a tramp freighter drink, dodge U-boats and rescue a shanghaied Swede (John Wayne) in the early days of World War II.

title: Silver Lode
description: A Nevada rancher (John Payne) is taken from his bride (Lizabeth Scott) by a killer (Dan Duryea) posing as a U.S. marshal on the Fourth of July.

title: The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes
description:
The Problem of Thor Bridge
Maria Gibson arranges to meet her children's governess at Thor Bridge, but is gunned down. The young governess is accused of murder, which forces her employer to enlist the aid of Sherlock Holmes.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E16 — Justice
Two men wanted by a Cheyenne tribe for murder seek refuge in Dodge City, and although Earp arrests the pair, the city refuses to press charges because the victims were Indians.

title: Stranger on Horseback
description: A circuit judge (Joel McCrea) rides in to break a ruthless cattle baron's stranglehold on a frontier town.

title: Through the Bible With Les Feldick
description: Les Feldick, an Oklahoma farmer and rancher with a special gift for teaching the Bible; his simple and nondenominational approach on the program "Through the Bible with Les Feldick" has reached millions around the world with the Gospel of Grace.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E17 — Shootin' Woman
A poor rancher woman struggling to marry off her daughter deals with trespassers trying to steal her land's resources and rumors that she has gold on her property.

Holmes is consulted by a man who is concerned about the sudden strange behavior of his employer, who has taken to visiting a ruined crypt at nighttime, and bones are later discovered in his furnace.

title: The Life and Legend of Wyatt Earp
description:
S02 E18 — The Man Who Rode With Custer
Earp must convince a disgraced Army captain that he holds no responsibility for Gen. Custer's devastating loss at Little Big Horn, but angry newcomers with a group of captive Indians seek to take revenge on the captain for the defeat.
